description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'TitlePriceRating' that displays a title, price, rating stars, and number of reviews for a food item, along with a custom clipper for styling the price tag.

classes.name: TitlePriceRating
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the title, price, star rating, and review count for a food item.

classes.name: PricerCliper
classes.description: A custom clipper class used to shape the price tag container with a specific polygonal shape.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the TitlePriceRating widget, arranging the title, rating, reviews, and price tag.

methods.name: priceTag
methods.description: Creates a styled container displaying the price, clipped with a custom shape.

methods.name: getClip
methods.description: Defines the clipping path for the price tag shape.

methods.name: shouldReclip
methods.description: Indicates whether the clipper should reclip when the clipper instance changes.
